newsitem.title: GERMANY: Hugo Boss eyes 5 pct growth in 97 results.
newsitem.headline: Hugo Boss eyes 5 pct growth in 97 results.

text.p: German clothing retailer Hugo Boss AG said on Monday that it expected continued strong earnings this year, predicting sales and earnings would rise by five percent in 1997.

In the text of a statement released before a news conference, Hugo Boss said: "We are projecting another very good earning for 1997. Based on pre-order volumes, we see good chances of being able to report an increase of five percent both for sales and earnings."
The forecast for 1997 results was made in the light of the expected improvement in the overall economic situation, the group added.
